_comment: ERC supply spec for the generated cells (layout/example_config.json,
issue #179): the four sg13g2_* streams route Metal1 only (spec row 3,
8-track single-row cells), so the stackup stops at GatPoly + Cont +
Metal1. Layer numbers are the config's layout.layers map: gatpoly 5/0,
cont 6/0, metal1 8/0 with its 8/25 label layer, activ 1/0, nsd 7/0,
Supplies are the config's process.vdd_net / process.vss_net names,
drawn as the row-edge Metal1 rails (layout/gen_layouts.py). One island
per supply is the default nets[].islands expectation.
ties[] names the two tap bands layout/gen_layouts.py draws per cell
(issue #73): the n-well tap is activ nsd inside the drawn n-well
(31/0) wired to the VDD rail; the substrate tap is activ psd outside
every n-well -- a native p-substrate with no drawn tub layer, so the
region is the n-well complement (well_layer null + well_complement_of)
-- wired to the VSS rail. tap_requires carries the implant boolean on
both: a bare activ tap_layer would match every device source/drain
diffusion in the same region and grade as degenerate
